title: Charlie Barnet's band personnel
summary: He recalls Bunny Briggs dancing with Barnet, and members including Al Killian, Chubby Jackson, Ralph Burns, Buddy DeFranco and singer Virginia Maxey.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: I remember Bunny Briggs when he was a young kid doing those things back there then. And the strange thing about Bunny, I worked with Charlie Barnett, and Bunny was dancing with that band for a while.
(Inaudible) Was he singing then at all?

Yeah. No, he just was dancing. Well, when I was with Barnett, Peanuts Holland, the trumpet player -- he's been in Europe for many years now -- he did some singing with Barnett, and we didn't have too much singing with the group, and --
who all was in Barnet's band when

When I was with Barnett? Let me see. Al Killiqn was on the band, on trumpet, and Dick Vance was on the band on trumpet, myself, and Chubby Jackson was on the band. This is before he went with Woody Herman. And Ralph Burns was on the band, later went with Woody Herman.

Buddy DeFranco was on the band, clarinet man, and -- see who else I can remember. Don Lamond was on the band, drummer. Lot of people knew Don. And those are about the guys I remember from the band, but he had some good players on the band.
who was singing with the band then?
Virginia Maxie. She was a fine little singer, you know. She's back singing now.
She's married to -- her husband writes a lot of tunes. What's his name out on the West Coast? He wrote Angel Eyes and all of those things, some fine tunes. But --
Last time I saw her she was singing with Georgie Auld. That was a long time ago.
